subject: Kickoff: Mutual Action Plan for Zephyr Health — Confirm goals & timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Price <olivia.price@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Mutual Action Plan for Zephyr Health — Confirm goals & timeline

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for walking me through your evaluation goals yesterday. I want to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can move from discovery to an actionable pilot timeline. High level ask here is: confirm the goals below, confirm who at Zephyr will own each row, and let us know availability for a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Goals (what success looks like for the pilot)
- Validate hallucination mitigation with our safety filters on your 500 clinical Q&A prompts (target F1 > 0.85)
- Measure 99th percentile latency under a 40 qps load on 4-token prompts (target < 300ms)
- Confirm integration approach for on-prem private deployment (network, KMS)

Proposed timeline (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm MAP owners & kickoff meeting
- Week 1–2: Share prompt set + test data; Redwood provides baseline run & evals
- Week 3: Pilot environment spin-up (Dedicated or Private)
- Week 4–5: Performance and quality tuning; executive checkpoint and decision to proceed to pilot expansion

Attachments: I attached a starter MAP template (Zephyr_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW for scope clarity. Please review the MAP and fill in the owner column where you can.

Do you have a preferred time for a 30-minute kickoff on Tue (5/18) or Wed (5/19) morning PT? If those don't work, suggest two windows and we will accommodate. Also, could you please loop in whoever owns procurement and security/IT so we can include them on the MAP?

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Zephyr_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Olivia Price <olivia.price@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@zephyrhealth.com>, Dana Chen <dana.chen@zephyrhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Mutual Action Plan for Zephyr Health — Confirm goals & timeline

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear summary. The goals look right; two small clarifications: 1) for latency we usually measure 95th and 99th — 99th at <300ms is what we care most about, 2) the hallucination target is fine but we'll also want a qualitative review with our clinical SMEs.

I'll own the program at a high level and will assign Marcus Lee (IT) to own environment/network details and Dana Chen (Legal) to review any privacy/KMS language in the SOW. I'm looping procurement so they can flag any standard T&Cs up front.

Availability: Tue 5/18, 10:00–10:30 PT works for me. Marcus is available after 11:00 PT; if he can join remotely at 11:00 PT we can do a quick 30–45 minute sync. Otherwise we can do 10:00 PT to align goals and have Marcus and Dana join for a follow-up technical + procurement call.

I'll have procurement take a look at the SOW and the MAP owners column before the meeting and try to pre-populate names.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Price
Senior Program Manager, Clinical Ops
olivia.price@zephyrhealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Olivia. Tue 5/18 at 11:00 PT so Marcus can join works for our team. I've updated the MAP with two suggested owners for the quality and performance rows (please see column B).

Next steps before the 11:00 PT kickoff:
- Zephyr: confirm owners in the MAP and share any additional SME names (clinical reviewer + IT contact)
- Redwood (Aditya/Marissa): run baseline eval on your prompt set and prepare a short results deck (we'll share 1 pager + topline numbers in advance)
- Legal/Procurement: review SOW draft attached and flag any non-starters

I've attached a slightly updated SOW that clarifies data handling and KMS options (SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf). We'll spend 15 minutes on scope and 20 minutes on owner/timeline at kickoff.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45 min)
1) Quick introductions (5)
2) MAP walkthrough + confirm owners (10)
3) Baseline eval toplines and proposed pilot configuration (10)
4) Next actions & who owns what (5–10)

See you Tue at 11:00 PT — invite coming to calendar.

Best regards,
Kimberly

[Attachment: SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf (application/pdf)]
